value_intent.description: Determine what should be investigated before making a durable capability decision.

semantic_observation.presented_problem: Repeated publishing failures in environment A are being attributed to an AI-agent capability limitation, despite one success with the same logical content in environment B; the team plans to remove the capability from future workflows.

basis: The planned capability removal is a durable workflow decision.
Different outcomes across execution environments materially weaken a capability-only causal attribution.
The cause of the repeated failures has not been established by the available evidence.

unknowns: The specific cause of the repeated failures in environment A.
Which differences between environments A and B affected publication.
Whether the successful attempt and failed attempts used equivalent execution paths beyond logical content.
dependencies: A durable capability decision depends on establishing whether failure is attributable to the agent, the environment, or the execution path.
conflicts: Repeated failure in environment A conflicts with success of the same logical content in environment B.
The team's current capability attribution is not conclusively supported by the available evidence.
constraints: No execution or deployment decision is authorized by this judgment.
Only the supplied evidence references are available.
changes: The team plans to remove the capability from future workflows.

evidence_basis: The situation states that the team currently believes the AI agent lacks the capability and plans to remove it from future workflows.
The authority context states that no execution or deployment decision is authorized by this judgment.
inferences: The available evidence does not establish that the AI agent lacks the capability.
Environmental or execution-path differences may explain the divergent outcomes.
Causal framing should be revisited before a durable capability decision is made.
assumptions: The phrase 'same logical content' does not establish that all publication conditions or execution steps were identical.
uncertainties: The provenance, comparability, and detailed conditions of the failed and successful attempts are unspecified.
The mechanism producing success in environment B and failure in environment A is unknown.

basis: Removing the capability would change how the team and future workflows may use the AI agent.
The planned decision depends on an unresolved causal attribution.
